scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: Neel searches a sorted row of fictional card numbers: two, four, six and eight. The goal is six. Tara moves a marker from left to right, counting one comparison for each examined card. Finding the third card takes three comparisons under this stated search method.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: Next the target is five. The search examines two, four and six. Since the row is known to be ascending, every later number is at least six, so five cannot appear later. Passing the target is a justified stopping condition only because this ordering guarantee is available.
scenes.speech: Next the target is five. The search examines two, four and six. Since the row is known to be ascending, every later number is at least six, so five cannot appear later. Passing the target is a justified stopping condition only because this ordering guarantee is available.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: The teacher then supplies an unsorted row with a smaller number near the end. Stopping at the first larger value would miss possible later matches. The team checks the whole row when necessary and records not found as a valid result instead of inventing a match to finish the activity.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: The list is guaranteed ascending: 2, 4, 6, 8. Search proceeds left to right. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.

scenes.dialogue: Can sorted search stop at six while looking for five?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: Yes. After passing five at six, all later values are at least six. This early stop depends on the ascending-order guarantee.
scenes.speech: Yes. After passing five at six, all later values are at least six. This early stop depends on the ascending-order guarantee.
scenes.dialogue: Stop after passing a target only when ascending order is known.
